description: This file defines the interface for a factory class that creates internal server implementations of IWebAudioPlayer for the Rialto media server. It includes method declarations for creating WebAudioPlayer instances with specific configurations and references external dependencies such as ISharedMemoryBuffer and IWebAudioPlayer.

classes.name: IWebAudioPlayerServerInternalFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating internal server implementations of IWebAudioPlayer, providing methods to instantiate WebAudioPlayer objects with specific configurations.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayerServerInternal
methods.description: Creates a WebAudioPlayer instance for internal server use, configured with client, MIME type, priority, optional config, shared memory buffer, and handle.
